channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Uzbekistan's Parliament Focuses on Social Development and Citizen Interests
item.description: Uzbekistan's parliament is tasked with evaluating laws' impact on citizens, controlling their execution, and incorporating public interests into state policy. This approach aligns with a UN resolution initiated by Uzbekistan, emphasizing parliaments' role in social development. The 150th Inter-Parliamentary Union Assembly was recently held in Tashkent.

item.title: Uzbek President Addresses Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev expressed gratitude for the warm welcome and excellent organization of the SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan. He congratulated the Kyrgyz people on their 35th anniversary of state sovereignty and noted Kyrgyzstan's development and international standing. Mirziyoyev also acknowledged Kazakhstan's progress and supported the SCO's agenda and decisions, highlighting its 25th anniversary and role in regional stability.

item.title: Uzbek President Reviews 25 Years of Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev participated in the jubilee 25th anniversary meeting of the SCO Heads of State Council in Bishkek. The meeting, chaired by Kyrgyzstan's President Sadyr Japarov, discussed achievements, future tasks for stability, cooperation, and development. Leaders also exchanged views on current international and regional issues. Participants congratulated Uzbekistan on its Independence Day and praised its domestic reforms and foreign policy.

item.title: UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Centre for Digital Solutions to Be Established in Almaty
item.description: Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev stated that global stability increasingly depends on responsible AI development. He announced that Kazakhstan will establish the UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Centre for Digital Solutions in Almaty. The center aims to scale up best practices, particularly for developing countries, and ensure technological progress benefits all humanity.

item.title: Bishkek Streets Largely Empty Due to SCO Summit Traffic Restrictions
item.description: Extensive traffic restrictions are in place in Bishkek on September 1 for the SCO summit, affecting 81 locations. While central streets appear clear on navigation apps, many are closed to traffic, causing vehicles to be absent. Some accessible roads experience congestion due to rerouted traffic.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan and Egypt Aim to Boost Economic and Political Cooperation
item.description: Kyrgyzstan and Egypt are set to expand economic cooperation, with discussions focusing on trade, investment, and industry. Egypt's role as an SCO dialogue partner was highlighted. Both nations aim to maintain momentum from President Japarov's 2025 visit, including opening the Kyrgyz Embassy in Cairo.

item.title: Tajik President: UN and SCO can help form a just world order
item.description: President Emomali Rahmon of Tajikistan stated that the UN and the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) can play a greater role in shaping a just, inclusive, and sustainable world order. Speaking at the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek, he emphasized their ability to strengthen their roles by relying on shared values and constructive interaction principles.

item.title: Kazakhstan offers to host headquarters of SCO Development Bank
item.description: President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev of Kazakhstan proposed launching SCO cross-border trade zones and supported China's initiative for an SCO Development Bank. He suggested the bank focus on infrastructure and technology projects. Kazakhstan is willing to host the bank's headquarters if member states reach a consensus, aiming to boost regional connectivity and trade.

item.title: Armenian PM Pashinyan meets US delegation in Bishkek to discuss strategic partnership
item.description: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan met with a US delegation led by Senator Steve Daines in Bishkek. They emphasized the importance of developing the Armenia-US strategic partnership across various sectors. Regional processes and communication projects like TRIPP were also discussed.

item.title: OPEC Fund provides $30 million loan for reconstruction of Rushan-Vardez road in Tajikistan
item.description: The OPEC Fund has allocated a $30 million loan for the first phase of the Rushan-Vardez road reconstruction project in Tajikistan. The project aims to strengthen a key transport corridor and improve connectivity with China. A partnership framework agreement for 2026-2028 was also signed.

item.title: EU and UK ambassadors compare Uzbekistan's current processes to European history
item.description: The EU ambassador sees parallels between Central Asia's current political processes and Europe's past, highlighting Uzbekistan's role in regional integration. The UK ambassador notes a shared belief in education and innovation, linking Uzbekistan's history to the Great Silk Road's role in knowledge exchange.

item.title: Kazakh President Highlights Fight Against Terrorism, Extremism, and Separatism at SCO Summit
item.description: Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev addressed the SCO summit, emphasizing the fight against terrorism, extremism, and separatism as a priority. He noted the growing risks of transboundary crises due to armed conflicts impacting global markets and supply chains. Tokayev also called for a ministerial conference on strategic stability and confidence-building measures in Eurasia.

item.title: Putin: UN Potential Not Fully Realized, Calls for Greater Representation
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated at the SCO summit in Bishkek that the UN's potential is far from fully realized. He emphasized the need to enhance the UN's effectiveness and expand representation, particularly in the Security Council, to include more countries from the Global South and East.

item.title: Iran Offers to Participate in Kyrgyzstan Oil Refinery Construction
item.description: Iran is ready to invest in building an oil refinery in Kyrgyzstan and supply crude oil, according to Tasnim media. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian also proposed establishing a logistics center in Iran for Kyrgyzstan. Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov invited Iranian oil exploration companies to projects in Kyrgyzstan.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek Concludes with Signing of 28 Documents
item.description: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, held on September 1, resulted in the signing of 28 documents. Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov chaired the meeting, where member states discussed security, anti-drug cooperation, digitalization, ecology, and logistics. The Bishkek Declaration on the SCO's 25th anniversary was a key political outcome.

item.title: Uzbek President Proposes SCO Industrial Cooperation Map and Development Bank
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev, speaking at the SCO summit in Bishkek, emphasized Central Asia's role and proposed developing an 'SCO-2040: Common Development Space' concept. He suggested creating an SCO Industrial Cooperation Map and launching an SCO Development Bank to foster regional prosperity and integration.

item.title: Uzbek President Outlines Key SCO Priorities at Anniversary Summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev defined the most pressing tasks for the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) at its anniversary meeting. The summit concluded with the adoption of the Bishkek Declaration and documents on strengthening multilateral cooperation for nuclear and physical security, and enhancing priority areas of collaboration.

item.title: Uzbek President Proposes SCO Industrial Cooperation Concept and Strategy
item.description: Speaking at the SCO summit in Bishkek, President Shavkat Mirziyoyev proposed the development of an "SCO-2040" concept and an industrial cooperation strategy. He emphasized Central Asia's central role in the SCO and highlighted growing geopolitical divisions, lack of trust, escalating conflicts, and erosion of international law.

item.title: Research Expedition Conducted on Surkhob Glacier in Tajikistan
item.description: Specialists from Tajikistan's National Academy of Sciences and Austria's ISTA university conducted a research expedition and monitoring of the Surkhob glacier from August 14-21. The expedition aimed to install meteorological and hydrological instruments, monitor the glacier's condition, and study climate change impacts. Samples were collected for laboratory analysis.

item.title: Uzbekistan Ranks Among World's Top 5 for Tourism Growth
item.description: In January-July 2026, Uzbekistan welcomed over 7.7 million foreign tourists, a 22.6% increase year-on-year. The country leads Central Asia in tourism development pace and ranks globally in the top five. Infrastructure projects, including airport modernizations and new tourist complexes, are underway.

item.title: UN Warns of Severe Consequences from Rapid Sea Level Rise
item.description: The UN reports that global sea levels are rising faster than ever, posing significant risks to populations, economies, health, culture, and human rights. The report highlights that rising seas are causing flooding, loss of livelihoods, and threats to coastal communities worldwide. This rise is linked to climate change, with an average increase of 4.7 mm per year between 2014-2023.

item.title: Dushanbe Increases Public Transport Fleet by 360 Vehicles
item.description: Dushanbe has increased its public transport fleet by 360 vehicles, a 20% rise, starting September 1. This includes buses, trolleybuses, and minibuses. The move aims to accommodate the increased passenger numbers with the start of the academic year. The city plans to gradually add more electric vehicles.

item.title: Iran Views SCO Summit as Opportunity to Counter US Policy
item.description: Iran's participation in the SCO summit offers strategic opportunities to boost trade and economic ties amid US-induced instability in the Persian Gulf, according to an Iranian lawmaker. The SCO platform is seen as a chance to expand economic partnerships and counter Washington's policies.

item.title: Nearly 30 Documents Signed at Bishkek SCO Summit
item.description: Around 30 documents were signed at the regular meeting of the heads of state of SCO member countries in Bishkek on September 1st. The Bishkek Declaration, commemorating the SCO's 25th anniversary, and documents aimed at strengthening multilateral cooperation were adopted.

item.title: SCO is World's Largest Regional Organization, Says Putin
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) is effectively the world's largest regional organization. Member states represent nearly half the global population and over a third of global GDP, possessing significant intellectual, technological, and natural resources.

item.title: Omurbek Babanov announces withdrawal from presidential race, ending political career
item.description: Former Prime Minister Omurbek Babanov has declared he will not run for president and has concluded his political career. The announcement marks a significant shift in the country's political landscape.

item.title: Trump labels Iran a 'state in crisis,' claims leadership is incapable
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has officially declared Iran a 'state in crisis,' asserting that its leadership is incapable of governing and has lost its military strength. He alleged that the government is not paying its military and police forces.

item.title: Putin highlights SCO as largest regional association, emphasizing trade and potential
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that the SCO is the largest regional association globally, encompassing nearly half the world's population and over a third of global GDP. He noted the bloc's significant intellectual, technological, and natural resource potential, emphasizing increased trade among member states as a key objective.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek Concludes with Signing of Key Documents
item.description: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek concluded with the adoption of several important documents, including amendments to the SCO Charter and regulations for a Universal Center. Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov announced the establishment of a Center for Combating International Organized Crime in Bishkek.

item.title: Belarus President Advocates Unified Digital Space for SCO Members
item.description: Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko called for the swift creation of a unified, open, and secure digital space within the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO). Speaking at the SCO Summit in Bishkek, he also supported establishing an SCO Development Bank to enhance economic ties and financial sovereignty, and increasing the use of national currencies in mutual settlements.

item.title: OIC Foreign Ministers Elect New Secretary-General, Discuss Palestine in Jeddah
item.description: Foreign ministers of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) met in Jeddah to elect Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed of Mauritania as the new Secretary-General and discuss the situation in Palestine. Tajikistan's Ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Akram Karimi, attended and spoke, highlighting Tajikistan's initiative for a decade of peace.

item.title: Tajik citizens in Russia can register residency via Amina app from September 1
item.description: Starting September 1, 2026, foreign citizens in Russia, including those from Tajikistan, must use the Amina mobile application for residency registration. Previously used in Moscow and the Moscow region, the app's scope has expanded to cover all foreign nationals entering Russia visa-free. The app allows individuals over 18 to register their place of residence.

item.title: Emomali Rahmon's speech at the 79th UN General Assembly session
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon addressed the 79th session of the UN General Assembly. His speech touched upon topics including the "cold war," artificial intelligence, "two-faced policy," and the situations in Palestine and Afghanistan.

item.title: Winning projects announced in Uzbekistan's participatory budgeting initiative
item.description: Over 2,195 projects have been selected as winners in Uzbekistan's participatory budgeting initiative, following the conclusion of the voting process. More than 10 million votes were cast nationwide. Details are available via the provided link.

item.title: Tajik Prime Minister Meets with OPEC Fund President to Discuss Cooperation
item.description: Tajikistan's Prime Minister Kohir Rasulzada met with the President of the OPEC Fund for International Development, Abdulhamid Alkhalifa, on August 31. They expressed satisfaction with bilateral relations and cooperation, anticipating further expansion. The signing of a Country Partnership Strategy for 2026-2028 was discussed.

item.title: Indian PM Modi Urges Putin to End Ukraine War and Seek Peaceful Resolution
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Russian President Vladimir Putin to end the war in Ukraine and resolve issues peacefully, according to excerpts from their August 31 conversation. Modi emphasized that continuing the war pushes humanity backward, while peace efforts offer hope.

item.title: Uzbekistan's Economy Grows 8.5% in First Half of 2026, Driven by Demand and Investment
item.description: Uzbekistan's economy expanded by 8.5% in the first half of 2026, accelerating from 7.7% in 2025. Growth is supported by consumer demand, investment, and services, with retail sales up 20.2% and capital investments increasing by 17.5%. Foreign direct investment reached $39.6 billion, with significant contributions from China and the Persian Gulf.

item.title: New Electric Train to Reduce Travel Time Between Tashkent and Andijan
item.description: A new Chinese-made CR200J electric train will soon operate between Tashkent and Andijan, with test runs currently underway. The train covers the distance in 4 hours, significantly reducing the current 6-7 hour journey. It can carry approximately 400 passengers and reach speeds of up to 160 km/h.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek: Leaders Discuss Regional Security, AI, and Future Projects
item.description: Bishkek hosts the 25th anniversary Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit with leaders from all 10 member states attending. Discussions focus on regional security, economic applications of AI, and future projects. The summit aims to adopt the Bishkek Declaration, building on the organization's evolution from a border security pact to a broader regional forum.

item.title: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon Attends Opening Ceremony of World Nomad Games
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon participated in the opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games in Bishkek on August 31. The games, held in Kyrgyzstan until September 6, coincide with Kyrgyzstan's Independence Day and the SCO summit. Rahmon held meetings with leaders of several SCO member states and other governments.
